decisions.rationale: The established theft term directly attests Stealing. Its internal negative and taking components do not have separate English members.
The first conventional adverb qualifies the theft definition; keep its DU ending and distinguish the second sexual-act occurrence.
First MA is the privative without in the theft clause.
First error-sense NOR supplies mistake, distinct from the later wealth noun and final mistaken verb.
GZHAN supplies the complete apostrophe-delimited lexical another. The bound genitive is not cut into a nonauthorized English subword.
Second NOR is the directly attested wealth sense, not the mistake sense in the adverb.

MTHU contributes power/force locally in superior force. HGM attests strength/power, while force is a separate reference comparandum; the full local clause supports a provisional force mapping without relabeling that reference as HGM.
DANG coordinates alternative means here as or, rather than mechanically and.
The complete inflected JAB BUS maps stealth, with JAB BU directly attested. Its agentive-s remains inseparable; no fabricated separate by member.

The complete negative perception phrase corresponds to undetected. TSHOR has an empty HGM scaffold, with reference perception and complete C01:193/C16:89 negative-know usage; this is contextual phrase evidence only. Keep the phrase whole and do not cut a positive detected stem or falsely fill the glossary.

The established possession idiom is the taking-possession predicate. Its complete master entry awaits HGM; the whole local351 and earlier348 corpus definitions support only a provisional correspondence.
BDAG GIR directly attests possession; the member is unique, whole and strictly inside the idiom. No inferred BYED PA/take child is added.
Second conventional adverb supplies the second purposely in the sexual-act definition.
Second negative MA supplies no in the mistaken-identity condition.
Final NOR directly attests mistaken. Identity and with are expanded context/manner framing and remain outside the tight word.

The complete lexical expression BGROD PAR BYA BA has HGM perform, with modal-going references separately recorded. It owns perform, not a fabricated positive proper stem; the negative permission is carried by the following MIN.
MIN owns only the negative im prefix in improper under the explicitly allowed im convention. The rest of proper is not split off as a positive lexical pair; keep the following PAR whole and unbanked.

The inflected going/engaging verb is verbal here. Its unrelated mined misery gloss is rejected for this context; going reference comparanda and the full local clause support the provisional engaging match.
The complete inflected technical term supplies Sexual misconduct. Desire/manner contributions in the surrounding construction remain distributed rather than falsely lexicalized as sex.

omissions.tib: ni; bound gyi; the bar/par manner endings; final closures
omissions.reason: Topic/copular, possessive and manner syntax is distributed across is/to/of/apostrophe/with/punctuation. No agentive-s is separated and no new positive or possessive subword rule is introduced.

The complete power/status construction supports the superior-force sense, but no exact DBANG CHA master entry was found and exclusive DBANG CHA/superior ownership is not sufficiently established. MTHU/force is retained provisionally; the uncertain remainder is not nulled.

Desire, manner and becoming jointly frame the sexual act, recast as a definition with engaging in kinds of sex. No isolated DOD PA/sex, SGO NAS/in, or GYUR BA/is pair is secure enough to bank; the glossary formula and mined senses are not proof of atomic ownership.

The explicit four-types continuation has no separate English exponent in351, but the next English352 explains Four types of sexual misconduct. This is a cross-segment rendering distribution, not an invitation to insert four into351 or to assert uncertain semantic absence with nulls.
